$comment: Requires CMake 4.2+. Schema v10 (3.31/4.x). Upgrade $schema hash from cmake.org/cmake/help/v4.2 when IDE validation matters.

configurePresets.$comment: apk_input empty = auto-download the pinned release APK (SHA-256 verified). Pick the patch combination with -DWC4_PATCH_<NAME>=ON/OFF.
configurePresets.name: default

apk_input.$comment: Leave empty to auto-download original.apk from the pinned GitHub release

apk_input_sha256.$comment: Expected SHA-256 of apk_input — empty prints the actual hash without verifying

deploy_variant.$comment: Variant installed by the deploy-* targets

adb_serial.$comment: adb device serial for deploy-adb — empty uses the default/only device

buildPresets.name: decompile
buildPresets.description: apktool d + decrypt JSON => pristine decompiled/

buildPresets.name: apks
buildPresets.description: Fresh copy + patch install + encrypt + apktool b + sign for every variant

buildPresets.name: deploy-waydroid
buildPresets.description: Install + launch deploy_variant via waydroid, then watch logs (deploy_debug_waydroid=OFF: bounded crash watch; ON: infinite tail)

buildPresets.name: deploy-adb
buildPresets.description: Install + launch deploy_variant on a phone via adb, then watch logs (deploy_debug_adb=ON: infinite tail; OFF: bounded crash watch). Set adb_serial to pick a device.

testPresets.name: default
testPresets.description: ctest patch validation — build the apks target first

workflowPresets.$comment: compile + install/launch via waydroid + log watch (bounded unless -Ddeploy_debug_waydroid=ON)
workflowPresets.name: deploy

workflowPresets.$comment: compile + install/launch on a phone via adb + log watch (infinite tail unless -Ddeploy_debug_adb=OFF; set adb_serial to pick a device)
workflowPresets.name: deploy-adb
